# awskills

> Portable agent skills — self-contained procedures an agent loads on demand.

Prompt knowledge dies in a transcript. A skill is a procedure written once, in a file, that any agent can load when the situation calls for it.

## Install

```
git clone https://github.com/Aitherium/awskills
```

## Use it in 30 seconds

Copy one .md into your agent's skills dir and tell it to use that skill.

## Composes with

- [awdk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdk/) — Build AI agent fleets — 3 lines, any backend, local or cloud.
- [awknowledge](https://aitherium.github.io/awknowledge/) — How to run a coding agent so the result survives — the laws, with evidence.

## Where it lives

- Repo: https://github.com/Aitherium/awskills
- Docs: https://aitherium.github.io/awskills/
- Manifest (keys + the one-line adoption story): https://aitherium.github.io/awskills/aither-manifest.json

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-skills.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.

Everything Aitherium, in one file for agents: https://aitherium.com/llms.txt
